description: Parse nginx error.log (data/error.log). Correlate to the access log on nginx.connection <-> nginx.error.connection -- the error log has no $request_id.

script.description: classify the error so it can be counted by cause, not just by level
script.source: String m = ctx.message ?: ''; String c = 'other'; if (m.contains('upstream timed out')) { c = 'upstream_timeout'; } else if (m.contains('Connection refused')) { c = 'upstream_refused'; } else if (m.contains('no live upstreams')) { c = 'no_live_upstreams'; } else if (m.contains('delaying request')) { c = 'rate_limit_delayed'; } else if (m.contains('limiting requests')) { c = 'rate_limited'; } else if (m.contains('upstream server temporarily disabled')) { c = 'upstream_disabled'; } else if (m.contains('SSL_do_handshake') || m.contains('while SSL handshaking')) { c = 'tls_handshake'; } else if (m.contains('upstream prematurely closed')) { c = 'upstream_closed'; } else if (m.contains('client prematurely closed') || m.contains('client closed connection')) { c = 'client_aborted'; } else if (m.contains('upstream sent too big header')) { c = 'upstream_bad_header'; } else if (m.contains('Connection reset by peer')) { c = 'upstream_reset'; } else if (m.contains('access forbidden by rule')) { c = 'forbidden_by_rule'; } else if (m.contains('No such file or directory')) { c = 'missing_file'; } else if (m.contains('buffered to a temporary file')) { c = 'response_buffered'; } else if (m.contains('worker_connections')) { c = 'worker_saturation'; } else if (m.contains('gracefully shutting down') || m.contains('reconfiguring') || m.contains('start worker') || m.contains('exit') || m.contains('SIGCHLD') || m.contains('signal') || m.contains('event method')) { c = 'lifecycle'; } ctx.nginx = ctx.nginx ?: [:]; ctx.nginx.error = ctx.nginx.error ?: [:]; ctx.nginx.error.cause = c;
